Bug_Title: EI2: May expose internal representation by creating a buffer which incorporates reference to array (EI_EXPOSE_BUF2)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a buffer which stores a reference to an external array or the array of an external buffer into
the internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the array would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the constructor of BufferExposureExample where the internalBuffer is directly assigned the reference of the initialData array. This allows external code to modify the internal state of the object by changing the contents of the array.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by modifying the array returned by the showBug method, which directly references the internalBuffer of the BufferExposureExample instance. This modification affects the internal state of the object, causing the assertion to fail.
